name: Site Alpha (C8 reference, as built)
notes: The C8 site EXACTLY as its committed config declares it, preserved so the defect stays visible and regression-tested. Installed charger nameplate is 1,612 kW (10x150 DCFC + 8x11 L2 + 6x4 AMR pad) against a 3,000 kW cap: an oversubscription ratio of 0.54:1. Every charger on this site running flat out simultaneously draws barely half the cap, so NO SCHEDULE CAN VIOLATE IT and is_binding() returns false. This is docs/BENCHMARK_CREDIBILITY.md's finding expressed as data instead of prose. R-4's observed band is 1.4:1 to 7:1; this site is on the wrong side of 1.0. Use site_alpha_binding for a benchmark where the cap is a real constraint.

tariff.notes: From the NES commercial-rate PDF, already held in ottoq_depot_tariffs. Demand basis is 30-minute NCP -- a Southeast regional trait (R-5), NOT a default. Energy rate 4.785 c/kWh is the base excluding the TVA fuel cost adjustment (~2.8-4 c/kWh), so total energy cost is understated here by design; the FCA is a pass-through that varies monthly.
